final: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id), 2) as percentage_female FROM client c JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A11 > 10000    -- Returns 50.39: of the 1,288 clients with accounts in the 8 districts where average salary exceeds 10,000, exactly 50.39% are women (649 female, 639 male).
